name: Matsubara Runa
source:
She is the only daughter of Seadream, a cosy restaurant on the Yume-no-Ura coastline.

Her parents divorced when she was young. She is a brave young girl who runs the restaurant with her mother. While helping out at the restaurant, she is a second-year student at a private school for girls. 

She is a pure, innocent, and lovely heroine. Of course, she is a virgin. Tetsuya confesses his feelings for her, but she is unable to take the final step. She is timid about love. There is a thought that has been closed up in the back of her mind until now. 

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=27394&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
